issues_status_handler_consistency_check.name: issues_status_handler_consistency_check
issues_status_handler_consistency_check.value: ("issues"."status" = 'pending' AND "issues"."handler_membership_id" IS NULL AND "issues"."handler_user_id" IS NULL) OR ("issues"."status" = 'in_progress' AND "issues"."handler_membership_id" IS NOT NULL AND "issues"."handler_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

workspace_invitations_active_email_uniqu.name: workspace_invitations_active_email_unique
workspace_invitations_active_email_uniqu.where: "workspace_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NULL AND "workspace_invitations"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "workspace_invitations"."superseded_by_invitation_id" IS NULL

workspace_invitations_delivery_state_che.name: workspace_invitations_delivery_state_check
workspace_invitations_delivery_state_che.value: ("workspace_invitations"."delivery_status" = 'pending' AND "workspace_invitations"."sent_at" IS NULL AND "workspace_invitations"."delivery_failed_at" IS NULL) OR ("workspace_invitations"."delivery_status" = 'sent' AND "workspace_invitations"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_invitations"."delivery_failed_at" IS NULL) OR ("workspace_invitations"."delivery_status" = 'failed' AND "workspace_invitations"."sent_at" IS NULL AND "workspace_invitations"."delivery_failed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_invitations"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)
